description: A round room with a chrome band at head height, running on through the wall. Pale stone, three matching chairs, and a floor laid in a spiral.

window.description: The curve of the lowest bead, out onto Kerbstone Row and, at the east side, a slice of Sorrel Way. In the evening the light comes in off the bright collar outside and lands on the ceiling.
window.name: the bulge glazing
